items.raw_excerpt: 随着大模型 Agent 从实验原型迈向核心业务生产，工程化的重心正经历从“验证可行性”向“追求确定性”的本质跃迁。Agent 的本质是“自主”、“涌现”、“不可预测”——这些词本身就和“确定性”对着干。但企业要的是什么？是可用、是可靠、是出了事能找到原因、是敢把核心业务交给它。那么，一个本质上不确定的系统，我们能把它变得足够“确定”吗？如果能，靠什么？可观测性在这个命题里，扮演的是什么角色？

title_i18n.en: Farewell to the "Semantic Black Box": As Agents Enter Production Environments, How Do We Tame Their "Unpredictability"?
title_i18n.es: Adiós a la "caja negra semántica": cuando los agentes entran en entornos de producción, ¿cómo domesticamos su "imprevisibilidad"?

excerpt_i18n.zh: 随着大模型 Agent 从实验原型迈向核心业务生产，工程化的重心正经历从“验证可行性”向“追求确定性”的本质跃迁。Agent 的本质是“自主”、“涌现”、“不可预测”——这些词本身就和“确定性”对着干。但企业要的是什么？是可用、是可靠、是出了事能找到原因、是敢把核心业务交给它。那么，一个本质上不确定的系统，我们能把它变得足够“确定”吗？如果能，靠什么？可观测性在这个命题里，扮演的是什么角色？
excerpt_i18n.en: As large model Agents transition from experimental prototypes to core business production, the engineering focus is undergoing a fundamental shift from "validating feasibility" to "pursuing determinism." The essence of an Agent lies in "autonomy," "emergence," and "unpredictability"—terms inherently at odds with "determinism." Yet what enterprises demand is usability, reliability, the ability to trace causes when issues arise, and the confidence to entrust it with core operations. So, can we make a fundamentally uncertain system sufficiently "deterministic"? If so, how? What role does observability play in this proposition?
excerpt_i18n.es: A medida que los agentes de modelos grandes avanzan desde prototipos experimentales hacia la producción central de negocios, el enfoque de la ingeniería está experimentando una transición fundamental de "verificar la viabilidad" a "buscar la determinación". La esencia de los agentes es "autonomía", "emergencia" e "impredecibilidad", conceptos que en sí mismos contradicen la "determinación". Pero, ¿qué buscan las empresas? Usabilidad, fiabilidad, capacidad de identificar causas cuando surgen problemas y confianza para asignarles tareas centrales del negocio. Entonces, ¿podemos hacer que un sistema inherentemente incierto sea lo suficientemente "determinado"? Si es posible, ¿cómo? ¿Qué papel desempeña la observabilidad en esta cuestión?

On March 27, 2026, at the Shanghai Xuhui West Bund International Conference Center, a dialogue on the deep integration of talent and industry in the AI era unfolded. As one of the key forums of the 2026 Global Developer Pioneer Summit (GDPS2026), the Science and Technology Innovation Partner Ecosystem Conference, themed "Symbiosis in Innovation, Uniting for the New," gathered heavyweight guests from academia and industry. These included Huang Qifan, Executive Vice Chairman of the Academic Committee of the China Institute for Innovation and Development Strategy and former Mayor of Chongqing; Liu Shaoxuan, Vice Dean of the Antai College of Economics and Management at Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Executive Dean of the Bank of China Technology and Finance Institute; and Ge Dongdong, Dean of the Institute of Intelligent Computing at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Shanshu Technology. Together, they explored a defining question of the era: as artificial intelligence transitions from technological breakthroughs to practical applications, how can we cultivate science and technology innovation partners and promote the integration of industry and research?

During the global innovation and transformation project roadshow session of the conference, judges from the Zhejiang Entrepreneurs Association, TusStar, Yuanfen Investment, and Yunfeng Capital provided professional evaluations, in-depth communication, and on-site guidance for various enterprise projects. They helped companies clarify development strategies, address implementation challenges, and define pathways for advancement.

The defining question of the era: Industry calls for a science and technology innovation partner ecosystem to overcome challenges in technology, business, and industry collaboration.

Currently, artificial intelligence is rapidly empowering countless industries. From cutting-edge explorations in scientific AI to deep integration into industrial scenarios, the high-quality development of the AI industry urgently requires a seamless collaborative system across technology, business, and industry. However, the sector still faces deep-seated bottlenecks: a disconnect between research outcomes and market demand, and misalignment between technology and capital.

Como uno de los foros clave de la Conferencia Global de Pioneros del Desarrollo 2026 (GDPS2026), la Cumbre del Ecosistema de Socios de Innovación Científica y Tecnológica, bajo el lema "Coexistencia en Innovación Científica y Tecnológica, Uniendo Fuerzas hacia lo Nuevo", reunió a destacadas figuras como Huang Qifan, vicepresidente ejecutivo del Comité Académico de la Sociedad China de Estrategia para la Innovación y el Desarrollo y exalcalde de Chongqing; Liu Shaoxuan, vicedecano de la Escuela de Economía y Gestión Antai de la Universidad de Shanghai Jiao Tong y decano ejecutivo del Instituto de Finanzas Tecnológicas del Banco de China; y Ge Dongdong, director del Instituto de Computación Inteligente de la Universidad de Shanghai Jiao Tong, cofundador y científico jefe de Shanshu Technology.

items.title: 对话邓智航｜以「龙虾」为起点，起底从单个 Agent 到 Agentic Web 的安全重构
items.raw_excerpt: OpenClaw 的爆火，让一个原本更多停留在技术圈内部的变化，突然变得具象起来。 当一个 Agent 可以跨应用执行任务、调用工具、在几乎没有人工干预的情况下完成复杂流程时，人们第一次直观地看到：AI 正在从“生成内容的工具”，转变为“参与行动的主体”。也正是在这一刻，安全问题迅速被推到前台。 但一个更值得注意的现象是，在几乎所有关于 Agent 安全的讨论中，问题的定义仍然高度集中在模型层面：输入是否被注入、输出是否越界、对齐是否失效。这种讨论路径本身并没有错，但它隐含着一个前提，即安全问题主要发生在“模型”这一单点之上。 问题在于，这个前提可能正在失效。当 Agent 不再只是响应指令，而是持续接收来自不同来源的信息、在多组件结构中做出决策、并通过工具链将决策转化为现实动作时，“安全”所指向的对象，已经不再是单一模型，而是一个由模型、记忆、工具、环境以及交互链路共同构成的系统。 在这样的系统中，风险不一定以“错误输出”的形式出现，也不一定以“瞬时失控”的方式爆发。它可能表现为决策过程中的偏移、信息在链路中的传递与放大，甚至是跨组件、跨主体之间的相互影响。 这也意味着，Agent 安全的问题，正在从“是否安全”，转向“如何被影响”。 在论文《From Secure Agentic AI to Secure Agentic Web》中，上海交通大学、上海创智学院张伟楠团队正是从这一转变出发，尝试将 Agent 安全从模型层面的鲁棒性问题，重新置于系统结构与运行机制之中进行讨论。 围绕这一问题，AI 科技评论与论文一作邓智航进行了对话。下文在不改变原意的前提下，对访谈内容进行了整理与呈现，试图还原其对于 Agent 安全问题“从模型走向系统”的整体理解。 论文链接：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.01564 Agent 安全，被理解错了吗？ AI 科技

excerpt_i18n.en:
The explosive popularity of OpenClaw has suddenly made tangible a change that was previously confined mostly within tech circles. When an agent can execute tasks across applications, call tools, and complete complex workflows with almost no human intervention, people see firsthand that AI is shifting from a "tool for generating content" to an "agent of action." It is precisely at this moment that security concerns are thrust into the spotlight.

However, a more noteworthy phenomenon is that in almost all discussions about agent security, the definition of the problem remains highly concentrated at the model level: whether inputs are being injected, outputs are exceeding boundaries, or alignment is failing. This line of discussion is not wrong in itself, but it implies a premise that security issues primarily occur at the single point of the "model."

The problem is that this premise may be becoming obsolete. When an agent no longer merely responds to instructions but continuously receives information from various sources, makes decisions within a multi-component structure, and translates those decisions into real-world actions through a toolchain, the focus of "security" is no longer a single model but a system composed of models, memory, tools, environment, and interaction pathways.

In such a system, risks may not manifest as "incorrect outputs" or erupt as "instantaneous loss of control." They could appear as deviations in the decision-making process, the transmission and amplification of information along pathways, or even interactions across components and agents.

excerpt_i18n.es: El éxito explosivo de OpenClaw ha hecho tangible un cambio que antes se limitaba principalmente al ámbito tecnológico. Cuando un Agente puede ejecutar tareas entre aplicaciones, invocar herramientas y completar procesos complejos con mínima intervención humana, la gente ve por primera vez de manera directa cómo la IA está pasando de ser una "herramienta que genera contenido" a un "sujeto que participa en acciones". Es precisamente en este momento cuando los problemas de seguridad saltan rápidamente al primer plano. Sin embargo, un fenómeno aún más notable es que, en casi todas las discusiones sobre la seguridad de los Agentes, la definición del problema sigue centrándose en gran medida en el nivel del modelo: si la entrada ha sido inyectada, si la salida excede los límites, o si la alineación se ha perdido.

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, MOVA ecosystem company Zero Boundary Singularity (MOVA TPEAK) announced the completion of a new round of financing worth tens of millions. The funds will be primarily allocated to three key areas: core technology R&D, expansion of the product portfolio, and global channel development. With a strategic focus on the health and wellness sector, the company leverages its dual engines of "AI + audio" and mature engineering capabilities to accelerate the construction of a comfortable and healthy ecosystem covering smart wearables, AI innovative hardware, and health and wellness. Established just six months ago, Zero Boundary Singularity has already completed the journey from technology development to global launch of its Clip Pro open-ear clip headphones, and its self-developed open-ear hook sports headphones are set to go on sale by the end of April.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, la empresa de la cadena ecológica MOVA, MOVA TPEAK, anunció la finalización de una nueva ronda de financiación de decenas de millones de yuanes. Estos fondos se destinarán principalmente a tres áreas clave: investigación y desarrollo de tecnología central, expansión de la matriz de productos y despliegue de canales globales. Con la salud como campo estratégico, la compañía, apoyándose en el doble motor de "IA + audio" y su capacidad de ingeniería madura, acelera la construcción de un ecosistema de bienestar y comodidad que abarca dispositivos portátiles inteligentes, hardware innovador de IA y salud integral. Fundada hace medio año, MOVA TPEAK ha completado el desarrollo tecnológico y el lanzamiento global de sus auriculares Clip Pro de tipo abierto, y sus auriculares deportivos de gancho abierto de diseño propio estarán disponibles a finales de abril.

excerpt_i18n.en:
I don't think an AI agent is a living entity or a digital twin; it's more like a superorganism. When discussing the future form of agents, Frank offered a rather sci-fi perspective. In his view, people have traditionally seen AI as a tool or a "digital twin" of humans, but with the advancement of agent technology, this understanding may soon become outdated. As early as last year, we had an in-depth conversation with Frank about various concepts related to agents. Frank holds a unique position in the AI community: on one hand, he is active in major offline tech gatherings, maintaining an almost instinctive excitement and curiosity about any technological developments; on the other hand, he has never stepped away from the technical front lines and is currently fully dedicated to an overseas acceleration and incubation project called "QLab."

In fact, Frank is better known to the public for his self-operated WeChat public account—AI Outlier Frank. When asked about the origin of "AI Outlier," Frank admitted that he aspires to be an "Outlier" in the AI era: to seek anomalies and become a new variable. In his view, unique and heterogeneous taste will be the most scarce resource in the future.

Frank attends offline AI events. This time, we met at a café. The interview lasted an hour and a half, and as it approached 11:30 a.m., he hurriedly got up to head to the next offline AI event for a presentation—a pace that has become almost routine for him lately.
excerpt_i18n.es: Creo que el agente de IA no es un ser vivo ni un doble, sino que se asemeja más a un supercuerpo. Al hablar sobre la forma futura de los agentes, Frank ofreció un juicio con un toque de ciencia ficción. En su opinión, la gente solía entender la IA como una herramienta o un "doble digital" humano, pero con el avance de la tecnología de agentes, esta comprensión podría quedar obsoleta pronto. Ya desde el año pasado, mantuvimos conversaciones profundas con Frank sobre diversas ideas relacionadas con los agentes. La identidad de Frank en el círculo de la IA es bastante particular: por un lado, es activo en grandes reuniones técnicas presenciales, manteniéndose al tanto de cualquier novedad tecnológica.
